meta.title: Markji Bridge
meta.description: Four action-based agent tools for Markji decks, chapters, cards, sync, conflicts and files: a single-file SQLite cache, plain-text search that ignores formatting, media and base64, queued batch edits, chapter detail/create/rename/sort, card archive, failure/conflict recovery, multi-process write locking, background sync tasks with progress and crash-resume, and file upload.
